description: Narrow and elongated. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. Short connecting link between entry and living area. Kitchen: single-wall, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. One active cook at a time. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: linear kitchen-dining-living, kitchen on side wall. Seating: Sofa near lower-left area facing into the living zone, with a round table/seating toward the right side near the exterior wall. Dining table (4 seats). TV on wall unclear. Cook may see TV from cooking position. Diners unclear if facing the TV. Entry: corridor entry, first thing visible on arrival is blank wall, L-shaped corridor, medium length. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Master suite (en-suite bathroom) — accessed via own door off corridor, no walk-in wardrobe. Master suite (en-suite bathroom) in a central position within the apartment. Storage: generous wardrobe storage. One bathroom (shower and toilet). Single bathroom — all household members share one shower, sequential morning routine. Suits: singles or couples. Not suitable for: wheelchair users (narrow elongated layout with tight circulation); large families (single bedroom only); people needing a home office (no desk space and dim bedroom); households requiring two separate sleeping zones.
